title: Monthly tithes report
summary: Shows tithes for a church and period.
useCases: Review tithes collected in a period
analysisFocus: How much tithe entered in the period
Whether the movement is concentrated in a treasury or account
Whether the result suggests growth, drop or concentration risk
managementQuestions: Did tithe income remain stable in the period?
Was the collected amount concentrated in one treasury?
Does the report suggest a relevant drop or inconsistency to review?

title: Income statement
summary: Summarizes revenue, direct costs, operating expenses and net result for a period.
useCases: Understand financial performance for the month
Review revenue, cogs, opex and net income
analysisFocus: Which categories brought the main income
Whether treasury balances and cost centers show attention points
managementQuestions: Did the church close the month with surplus or deficit?
What consumed most of the income?
Is there a treasury with negative balance or a center with unusually high spending?

title: DRE report
summary: Shows the statement of results for the period with revenue, direct costs, operational expenses and net result.
useCases: Analyze the result of the month
Review gross revenue, direct costs, operating expenses and net result
analysisFocus: Pressure from direct costs and operating expenses
managementQuestions: Was the operational result healthy for the month?
What categories explain the profit or loss?
Do expenses seem too high relative to revenue?

title: Patrimony inventory report
summary: Supports inventory review of church assets, including controlled items, verification status and patrimony tracking.
useCases: Review church goods under patrimony control
Prepare inventory follow-up and physical verification
Understand which assets need inventory action or lifecycle updates
analysisFocus: Items that may need maintenance, disposal or reassignment
managementQuestions: Which assets still need inventory action?
Are there items with status requiring follow-up?
Does the inventory suggest patrimony control weaknesses?
